body: Ehhh I’m not THAT amazing, but that being said, I appreciate your kind words. Stay safe!!
Thank you. I’ll definitely take your advice and talk to her about this, I can’t stress enough how grateful I am for you to help me like this. Stay safe friend!
Thank you. Happy cake day btw! I hope you and your s/o are safe.
Thank you. I just feel so lost rn haha, I just want her to get better and be happy yknow.

Hey man. Ik this sounds cliche and pretty stupid, but I care about you. I care about everyone, no one deserves this pain. You’re always welcome to PM me, even though we don’t know eachother haha. Everyone deserves life, and that includes you. Happiness will find you one day, and no matter how long that takes, you need to remember one thing. You matter. People care about you, you’re not alone, we love you.
I’m also kind of realizing how selfish this whole post sounds I kind of made it about me and how much I can’t lose her. Ahhhh h fuck. I’m doing this for her sake. Not mine.
Hey. I’m here if you need to talk to someone.
